subject: E-Commerce
title: StockX and the Sneaker Market
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on StockX and the Sneaker Market.

hook.text: StockX authenticates every sneaker sold on its platform. It turned shoes into a stock market with bids and asks.

buildup.text: StockX charges a 10% transaction fee but guarantees the product is authentic. Trust justifies the markup.

discovery.text: Some sneakers on StockX trade above retail price for years. A Nike Dunk bought at $100 can resell for $500.

twist.text: Even StockX has had authentication failures. Fake sneakers occasionally pass inspection, damaging the trust premium.

climax.text: StockX proved that authentication creates a premium marketplace. Trust is the product; sneakers are just the vehicle.

punchline.text: Every pair authenticated, 10% fee. StockX proved trust can be a premium.

quiz.question: What makes StockX different from other sneaker resale platforms?
options: Every item is physically authenticated before being shipped to the buyer
